title: halogen-flash backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the halogen-flash provider (Phase 12). x-flag names the exact HALOGEN_* env var; env.py + driver.py remain the executable mapping. Upstream flags the driver does not wire yet carry x-supported: false (documented, disabled in the UI). The (api, engine) port pair is hashed into the engine's on-disk prompt-cache fingerprint and must stay stable across restarts (see env.derive_static_ports).

artifacts.title: Model files
artifacts.description: Checkpoint, tokenizer, MTP head, and vision tower artifacts resolved by the driver before spawn (local path or HuggingFace descriptor). Leave the checkpoint and tokenizer blank to use what the engine image ships/derives (nothing is exported for them).

model.title: Checkpoint
model.description: Primary .hgn checkpoint. A HuggingFace descriptor is the ONLY case where the provider downloads (into MODELS_DIR/<repo>/<file>, with progress in the admin); {path} is used as-is and must already exist. Leave blank to download nothing here: HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT is then not exported, so the image entrypoint serves its own default head under /models and pulls it (plus its companions) via HALOGEN_DOWNLOAD.

tokenizer.title: Tokenizer
tokenizer.description: Tokenizer artifact. The engine expects a tokenizer DIRECTORY: use {path} pointing at a local directory (exists() accepts file or dir). A {source:hf,repo,file} descriptor must name a SINGLE downloadable file (the downloader is file-only; it cannot fetch a directory tree) — unpack the tokenizer folder locally and reference it by path. Resolved path exported as HALOGEN_TOKENIZER. Leave blank to export nothing: the engine uses the checkpoint's sidecar tokenizer/ directory, or downloads it from HALOGEN_DOWNLOAD.

mtp_head.title: MTP head
mtp_head.description: Multi-token-prediction head weights for speculative decoding. Resolved path exported as HALOGEN_MTP_HEAD.

vision_tower.title: Vision tower
vision_tower.description: Vision tower artifact: hf-file descriptor / local path, or true to auto-look beside the checkpoint, or false to disable. Exported as HALOGEN_VISION_TOWER (resolved path, or 1/0 for booleans).

max_tok.title: Max tokens
max_tok.description: Hard cap on total tokens (prompt + generation) handled per request.

rope_yarn.title: YaRN RoPE scaling
rope_yarn.description: YaRN rope scaling factor applied at load (0 = use the checkpoint's own setting).

admit_chunk.title: Admission chunk
admit_chunk.description: Tokens admitted to the KV pool per admission step.

admit_ticks.title: Admission ticks
admit_ticks.description: Scheduler ticks per admission chunk (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

indexer_budget.title: Indexer budget (MiB)
indexer_budget.description: Attention indexer memory budget; changing it alters retrieval numerics.

kv_slots.title: KV slots
kv_slots.description: KV cache slots = engine request concurrency. The driver reports this as effective_capacity.

kv_pool_positions.title: KV pool positions
kv_pool_positions.description: Total pooled KV positions shared across slots.

kv_pool_fit.title: KV pool fit
kv_pool_fit.description: Fit the KV pool to available memory (0 = off, 1 = on).

host_reserve_gib.title: Host reserve (GiB)
host_reserve_gib.description: Host RAM kept free of the KV / cache pools.

cache_dir_enabled.title: Disk cache enabled
cache_dir_enabled.description: Gates HALOGEN_CACHE_DIR: persist the prompt cache under <CACHE_DIR>/halogen-flash. The dir is exported (and created) only when true.

cache_prune_old.title: Prune old entries
cache_prune_old.description: Prune stale cache entries at startup (0 = off, 1 = on).

prompt_cache.title: Prompt cache mode
prompt_cache.description: 0 = off, 1 = memory only, 2 = disk-backed. Mode 2 changes cached numerics across restarts.

cache_inplace.title: In-place cache updates
cache_inplace.description: Update cache entries in place instead of copy-on-write.

cache_entries.title: Cache entries
cache_entries.description: Maximum number of cached prompt entries.

cache_branches.title: Cache branches
cache_branches.description: Maximum cached branch points per entry.

cache_snap3.title: Snap-3 checkpointing
cache_snap3.description: Snap-3 checkpoint layout for cache entries (0 = off, 1 = on).

cache_full.title: Cache full turns
cache_full.description: Cache full conversation turns, not just shared prefixes.

cache_file.title: Cache file
cache_file.description: Explicit cache file path (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider — the cache lives in HALOGEN_CACHE_DIR).

prefill_chunk.title: Prefill chunk
prefill_chunk.description: Tokens per prefill chunk when warming the prompt cache.

drafter_default.title: Default drafter
drafter_default.description: Default drafter engine for speculative decoding (e.g. 'mtp', 'ngram', 'none').

pld.title: PLD (N,K)
pld.description: Prompt-lookup decoding parameters as 'N,K' (N = candidate length, K = min match).

spec_adapt.title: Spec adapt (W,floor,R)
spec_adapt.description: Adaptive speculation parameters as 'W,floor,R' (window, accept floor, retry rate).

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.description: Default constrained-decoding grammar for structured output.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Default sampling temperature (server-side default for requests that omit it).

min_p.title: Min-p
min_p.description: Minimum probability cutoff relative to the top token.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Repetition penalty scale (1.0 = disabled; upstream flag, not yet wired by this provider).

max_tokens_default.title: Max tokens default
max_tokens_default.description: max_tokens applied when the request omits it.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Named effort level for reasoning models.

enable_thinking.title: Enable thinking
enable_thinking.description: Turn chain-of-thought emission on/off (0 = off, 1 = on).

thinking_answer_room.title: Thinking answer room
thinking_answer_room.description: Tokens reserved for the answer after the thinking budget.

thinking_budget_message.title: Thinking budget message
thinking_budget_message.description: Message emitted when the thinking budget is exhausted (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

eos_guard.title: EOS guard
eos_guard.description: Guard against premature EOS during reasoning (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

template_unchecked.title: Template unchecked
template_unchecked.description: Skip chat-template validation on input (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

composable_context.title: Composable context
composable_context.description: Enable the composable-context preview (0 = off, 1 = on). Changes context assembly numerics.

composable_context_floor.title: Composable floor
composable_context_floor.description: Minimum resident tokens when composable context is enabled.

composable_context_bytes.title: Composable bytes
composable_context_bytes.description: Byte budget for composable context segments.

vision_max_pixels.title: Vision max pixels
vision_max_pixels.description: Maximum image pixels fed to the vision tower (larger images are downscaled).

npu_models.title: NPU model ids
npu_models.description: Bare upstream NPU model ids (e.g. 'qwen3-embedding-0.6b') or local paths — NOT hf-file descriptors. Emitted as HALOGEN_NPU_MODELS (comma-joined) only when the host NPU probe passes; the pinned files are pre-downloaded into MODELS_DIR/npu/<id>/ at start.

npu_with_gpu.title: NPU with GPU
npu_with_gpu.description: Allow NPU small models alongside a GPU-loaded main model (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

npu_verify.title: NPU verify
npu_verify.description: Verify NPU outputs against the CPU path (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

npu_emb_batch.title: NPU embedding batch
npu_emb_batch.description: Embedding batch size on the NPU (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

npu_queue.title: NPU queue depth
npu_queue.description: NPU submission queue depth (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

api_port.title: API port
api_port.description: Flash API listen port (all HTTP traffic). Part of the disk-cache fingerprint pair: when absent, both ports are derived deterministically from MACHINE_UID in the 8200-8289 static range (no schema default).

engine_port.title: Engine port
engine_port.description: Private engine port (referenced via HALOGEN_ENGINE). Must be pinned together with api_port for fingerprint stability (no schema default).

bind.title: Bind address
bind.description: Listen bind address. The provider hardcodes 127.0.0.1; this config field is not yet wired.

sse_keepalive_s.title: SSE keepalive (s)
sse_keepalive_s.description: Keep-alive ping interval for SSE streams.

queue_timeout.title: Queue timeout (s)
queue_timeout.description: Max time a request waits for a free KV slot before failing.

verbose.title: Verbose logging
verbose.description: Verbose engine logging (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

startup_progress.title: Startup progress
startup_progress.description: Print load-progress lines at startup (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

engine_watchdog_s.title: Engine watchdog (s)
engine_watchdog_s.description: Engine hang watchdog timeout (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

engine_watchdog_defer_s.title: Watchdog defer (s)
engine_watchdog_defer_s.description: Grace period before the watchdog arms (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

engine_wait_s.title: Engine wait (s)
engine_wait_s.description: Max wait for the engine to come up (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

flash_pin_trunk.title: Pin trunk
flash_pin_trunk.description: Pin the cache trunk in memory (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

frag_warn_blocks.title: Fragmentation warn blocks
frag_warn_blocks.description: Block count above which fragmentation is logged (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

frag_warn_stalls.title: Fragmentation warn stalls
frag_warn_stalls.description: Stall count above which fragmentation is logged (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

dmalloc_log.title: Debug malloc log
dmalloc_log.description: Debug allocator log path (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

prefill_cancel.title: Prefill cancel
prefill_cancel.description: Allow cancelling in-flight prefill (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

prefill_keep_trunk.title: Prefill keep trunk
prefill_keep_trunk.description: Keep the cache trunk after a cancelled prefill (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

ngram_gather_threads.title: Ngram gather threads
ngram_gather_threads.description: Threads gathering ngram-draft candidates (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

matmul_tuning_file.title: Matmul tuning file
matmul_tuning_file.description: Persistent matmul autotuning cache path (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

gguf_cache.title: GGUF cache
gguf_cache.description: Cache converted GGUF tensors (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

gguf_threads.title: GGUF threads
gguf_threads.description: Threads converting GGUF tensors (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

ck_overlay.title: Checkpoint overlay
ck_overlay.description: Checkpoint overlay level; changes output numerics (upstream flag; not yet wired by this provider).

download.title: Auto-download repo
download.description: Repo the ENGINE downloads from at start (its maybe_download pass): the checkpoint itself when absent, then its overlay sidecar, ngram table and vision tower, and the tokenizer — written into the checkpoint's own directory under MODELS_DIR. The provider never downloads for a blank artifact selection; this is what makes a blank selection work. Unset falls back to the artifacts.model repo when that is a HuggingFace descriptor, else to this image's weights repo. An empty string forbids engine downloads entirely (air-gapped hosts).
